```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(DT)

read_tsv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  df <- tryCatch(read.delim(path, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, comment.char = "#"), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df
}

show_table <- function(path, title) {
  cat(paste0("\n\n## ", title, "\n\n"))
  df <- read_tsv_safe(path)
  if (is.null(df)) {
    cat("No data available.\n")
  } else {
    print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(df, options = list(scrollX = TRUE))))
  }
}

show_plot <- function(path, title) {
  cat(paste0("\n\n### ", title, " (plot)\n\n"))
  if (!is.na(path) && file.exists(path)) {
    cat(paste0("![](", path, ")\n"))
  } else {
    cat("No plot available.\n")
  }
}
```

# Sample summary

```{r sample-summary, results='asis'}
show_table(params$sample_summary, "Samples")
```

# Repertoire exploration

```{r explore, results='asis'}
show_table(params$explore_table, "Clone volume / length / count")
show_plot(params$explore_png, "Exploration")
```
